name: com.midmanstudio.allthingsjiggle
displayName: All Things Jiggle - Bone Jiggle Physics
description: Jiggle physics for bone chains: hair, tails, ears, cloth strips and chests. A dependency-free Rust core (jiggle_core) behind a C interface and a managed C# reference kernel that give the same bits, with plain C# bindings that need no Unity engine references. Standalone and game-agnostic.
